traits.name: Stout Arm
traits.flavour: Swings a little harder than the job needs.

traits.name: Quick Hands
traits.flavour: Never waits for a second invitation.

traits.name: Keen Eye
traits.flavour: Spots the gap in the armour before anyone else.

traits.name: Thick Skin
traits.flavour: Bruises easily, notices rarely.

traits.name: Well Patched
traits.flavour: Every tear in the cloak mended twice over.

traits.name: Gentle Touch
traits.flavour: Ties bandages that actually stay on.

traits.name: Green Thumb
traits.flavour: Seeds sprout a day early wherever it walks.

traits.name: Patient Line
traits.flavour: Can sit by the water from dawn to dusk and call it a good day.

traits.name: Stone Sense
traits.flavour: Hears where the vein runs by tapping the wall.

traits.name: Steady Axe
traits.flavour: Fells a tree in one clean, unhurried rhythm.

traits.name: Trail Reader
traits.flavour: Reads a muddy trail like a letter from home.

traits.name: Rune Hummer
traits.flavour: Hums along with the stones until they answer.

traits.name: Ink-Stained
traits.flavour: Reads every page, the footnotes twice.

traits.name: Hammer Rhythm
traits.flavour: Keeps time with the anvil, even in its sleep.

traits.name: Tinkerer
traits.flavour: Takes everything apart just to see why it works.

traits.name: Daydreamer
traits.flavour: Thinks best while staring at clouds.

traits.name: Born Organiser
traits.flavour: Keeps a list of its lists.

traits.name: Quick Study
traits.flavour: Learns a trade by watching it done once.

traits.name: Goblin-Wise
traits.flavour: Knows every goblin trick, and two they never thought of.

traits.name: Bone Breaker
traits.flavour: Makes sure the dead stay down the second time.

traits.name: Web Shaker
traits.flavour: Shakes out every web for whatever got stuck in it.

traits.name: Magpie
traits.flavour: Pockets anything with writing on it.

traits.name: Haggler
traits.flavour: Has never once paid the first price asked.

traits.name: Iron Will
traits.flavour: Tired is a word for other people.

traits.name: Duelist
traits.flavour: Fights best with one foe and plenty of room.

traits.name: Spellwright
traits.flavour: Drafts every spell on paper before casting it.

traits.name: Sharpshooter
traits.flavour: Aims for the knot in the plank, and hits it.

traits.name: Field Medic
traits.flavour: Carries a spare of everything, including patience.

traits.name: Rallying Voice
traits.flavour: Its shout carries over any din, and lifts every arm.

traits.name: Dragon Scholar
traits.flavour: Has read about every scale, and where it is loose.

traits.name: Salt Pockets
traits.flavour: Keeps salt in every pocket, just in case.

traits.name: Purse Finder
traits.flavour: Checks every belt pouch twice on the way past.

traits.name: Scroll Hound
traits.flavour: Can smell old parchment through a stone wall.

traits.name: Silver Tongue
traits.flavour: Talks a price down, then down again, then thanks you for it.

traits.name: Bright Pupil
traits.flavour: Asks the one question everybody else missed.

traits.name: Hothead
traits.flavour: Charges in first and catches its breath later.

traits.name: Night Owl
traits.flavour: Works by candlelight, and sleeps through the harvest.

traits.name: Whirlwind
traits.flavour: A blur of blows and a great deal of dust.

traits.name: Giant Slayer
traits.flavour: The bigger they are, the louder they land.

traits.name: Master Angler
traits.flavour: Knows what bites, when, and what it is thinking.

traits.name: Guild Patron
traits.flavour: Every broker in Goldmill owes it a favour.

traits.name: Hoarder
traits.flavour: Carries everything it finds, and it shows.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.flavour: Leaves no guard up, and no foe standing either.

traits.name: Starborn
traits.flavour: Born under a comet, and never quite came down.

traits.name: Heart of the Forge
traits.flavour: Every anvil in the room rings as it walks past.

traits.name: Tide Caller
traits.flavour: Rivers bend a little toward it, and so do the fields.

traits.name: Fate's Favourite
traits.flavour: Things simply turn up wherever it happens to be.

traits.name: Unshaken
traits.flavour: Stood in the storm so long the storm got bored.
